assert: no test was loosened/disabled (.skip / xfail / @pytest.mark.skip / # type: ignore) in tracked source
cmd: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1; if (set +e; git grep -nE '\.skip\(|\.only\(|xfail|pytest\.mark\.skip|# *type: *ignore|@ *unittest\.skip' -- 'test*' 'tests' 'spec*' ':(exclude)*relay*' >/dev/null 2>&1); then false; else test "$?" -eq 1; fi
